result.instructions: Tools for Boxtal, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which parcel points near 75001 accept Mondial Relay parcels?"; "What is the status and tracking history of shipping order 1234?"; "Create a shipment of a 2 kg parcel to Lyon with Colissimo.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Boxtal data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run boxtal_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run boxtal_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run boxtal_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. boxtal_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: boxtal_list_content_categories
tools.title: List content categories
tools.description: List the Boxtal content categories (what a parcel contains) that a shipping order accepts. Boxtal API: GET /v3.1/content-category.

language.description: Language of the labels, for example fr or en.

tools.name: boxtal_find_parcel_points
tools.title: Find parcel points
tools.description: Find parcel pickup and drop-off points (relay points, lockers) near an address, optionally for chosen networks. Boxtal API: GET /v3.1/parcel-point.

countryIsoCode.description: Two-letter ISO country code of the reference location, for example FR.

number.description: House number of the reference location.

searchNetworks.description: Networks to search, for example MONR (Mondial Relay) or UPSE (UPS). Omit for all.

tools.name: boxtal_get_shipping_order
tools.title: Get a shipping order
tools.description: Get one Boxtal shipping order: its status (PENDING, REQUESTED, CONFIRMED or CANCELLED), dates and prices. Boxtal API: GET /v3.1/shipping-order/{id}.

id.description: Boxtal shipping order id (shippingOrder.id returned when the order was created).

tools.name: boxtal_get_tracking
tools.title: Get shipment tracking
tools.description: Get the tracking history of the packages in a shipping order (status, events, tracking number). Boxtal API: GET /v3.1/shipping-order/{id}/tracking.

id.description: Boxtal shipping order id (shippingOrder.id returned when the order was created).

tools.name: boxtal_get_shipping_documents
tools.title: Get shipping documents
tools.description: Get the shipping documents of an order (label, proforma, CN23, voucher) with their download URLs. Boxtal API: GET /v3.1/shipping-order/{id}/shipping-document.

id.description: Boxtal shipping order id (shippingOrder.id returned when the order was created).

tools.name: boxtal_create_shipping_order
tools.title: Create and order a shipment
tools.description: WRITE: creates AND ORDERS a real shipment on the customer's Boxtal account, which is billed to that account. Use it only when the user asks to ship that parcel. The account must have deferred payment (paiement différé) enabled; otherwise Boxtal returns an error with its reason. Choose the carrier with shippingOfferCode (see the Boxtal offer code list) or shippingOfferId (a hosted contract offer). Boxtal API: POST /v3.1/shipping-order.

shippingOfferCode.description: Transport offer code, for example CHRP-Chrono13 or UPSE-Standard. Give this or shippingOfferId.

shippingOfferId.description: Id of an offer from a hosted contract. Give this or shippingOfferCode.

expectedTakingOverDate.description: Date the carrier should collect the parcel, yyyy-mm-dd.

countryIsoCode.description: Two-letter ISO country code, for example FR.
Two-letter ISO country code, for example FR.

originCountry.description: Two-letter ISO code of the country of origin.

tools.name: boxtal_cancel_shipping_order
tools.title: Cancel a shipping order
tools.description: WRITE: cancels a shipping order on the customer's Boxtal account. The cancel can fail once the carrier has taken the parcel. Boxtal API: DELETE /v3.1/shipping-order/{id}.

id.description: Boxtal shipping order id (shippingOrder.id returned when the order was created).
